### n8n vs Zapier vs Make Pricing Calculator (2026–2027): Real Self-Hosted Savings / Calculadora de Costos n8n vs Zapier vs Make (2026–2027): Ahorro Real Self-Hosted
- EN: https://gabhack.github.io/turingtec-agent-studio/compare/n8n-vs-zapier-vs-make-calculator/ | ES: https://gabhack.github.io/turingtec-agent-studio/es/compare/n8n-vs-zapier-vs-make-calculator/
- BLUF: At 10,000 monthly workflow runs averaging 6 steps (60,000 tasks/month), Zapier costs ~$5,748/year and Make costs ~$1,284/year—while self-hosted Docker n8n runs for ~$180/year (~$15/mo VPS, $0 software fee), saving up to $5,568/year.

### AWS FinOps Open-Source Tools Compared (2026–2027): aws-finops-guard vs Infracost vs OpenCost / Herramientas Open-Source FinOps AWS (2026–2027): aws-finops-guard vs Infracost vs OpenCost
- EN: https://gabhack.github.io/turingtec-agent-studio/compare/aws-finops-open-source-tools/ | ES: https://gabhack.github.io/turingtec-agent-studio/es/compare/aws-finops-open-source-tools/
- BLUF: Infracost estimates pre-deploy Terraform PR diffs and OpenCost tracks Kubernetes pods, while aws-finops-guard audits live AWS + LLM token waste locally via CLI or Claude/Cursor MCP Server and outputs safe Terraform HCL fixes.

### Clinic WhatsApp AI Bot & Anti-No-Show ROI Calculator (2026–2027) / Calculadora ROI de Agente IA WhatsApp y Anti-Inasistencias para Clínicas (2026–2027)
- EN: https://gabhack.github.io/turingtec-agent-studio/compare/clinic-whatsapp-ai-bot-roi/ | ES: https://gabhack.github.io/turingtec-agent-studio/es/compare/clinic-whatsapp-ai-bot-roi/
- BLUF: A clinic handling 300 monthly WhatsApp inquiries with a 22% no-show/missed-lead rate at $75/visit loses ~$4,950/month. Recovering 65% via 24/7 booking and 24h/2h reminders adds ~$3,225/month ($38,700/year)—paying back a $690 pilot in under 7 days.
